portfolio_source: Actual TP exits from a separately replayed V03_2R portfolio on common Q1; not a selection of the61 V03_3R trades
entry_stop_quantity: Keep the exact original TP2R trade entry, initial stop and quantity; no resizing, trailing, break-even or new entry at2R
costs: Use the exact params of that original trade cost scenario; fee half at entry/exit, market slip, target limit without exit slip
target_execution: Frozen structural_path: executable bid for long/ask for short; one tick penetration required
horizon: Same-day hard16:00 Europe/London; original parameters must imply exactly that deadline
same_M1: Do not discard original TP2R minute; count modelled higher thresholds there separately as SAME_M1_AS_2R, never as proven strictly after the2R fill
later_M1: Terminal observation in a later M1 labelled LATER_M1_AFTER_2R; exact intraminute fill time remains unknown
ambiguous_stop_and_target: Frozen stop-first convention, flag ambiguity; not proof that the stop necessarily occurred first in ticks
deadline: Frozen TIME open-quote exit has priority over that minute's high/low; no threshold counted at/after the deadline
missing_data: Unknown remaining path, never a non-hit; a3R hit already resolved remains true even if4R/5R become unknown
original_TP2R_validation: Recompute original2R path with frozen engine; require true TP, matching target/entry/quantity-derived risk/known cash and modelled close time
portfolio_limit: Independent overlapping hypothetical continuations; never sum into another account equity or claim FTMO results
interpretation: Planned net quote-R thresholds, not exactly realized EUR cash-R; development2021 already viewed
